cover.report_type: Seven days before a primary election

_meta.notes: Handwritten. Line 1 Columns A and B are written with no cents at all ('$15,490' and '$41,195') — recorded exactly as printed. Summary Page header box is blank. Arithmetic closes.

contributions.detail: exact (15,490.00 = 15,490). All three Schedule A attachment pages gated exactly against their own printed 'Subtotal for this page' (7,070.00 + 3,190.00 + 5,230) and the sum equals the printed 'Total Contribution' on p6 = Summary Page line 1.

expenditures.detail: exact (25,514.45 = 25,514.45). All three Schedule B attachment pages gated exactly (12,338.81 + 11,377.37 + 1,798.27) and the sum equals the printed 'Total Expenditures' on p10 = Summary Page line 2.

itemized.page_subtotal_gates: p4 rows 7,070.00 vs printed 'Subtotal for this page' $7,070.00; p5 rows 3,190.00 vs printed 'Subtotal for this page' $3,190.00; p6 rows 5,230.00 vs printed 'Subtotal for this page' $5,230; p8 rows 12,338.81 vs printed 'Subtotal for this page' $12,338.81; p9 rows 11,377.37 vs printed 'Subtotal for this page' $11,377.37; p10 rows 1,798.27 vs printed 'Subtotal for this page' $1,798.27 - all six attachment pages gate EXACTLY.
itemized.escalation_note: p8 subtotal re-read: the 90 dpi classification sheet showed '$12,336.81', which would have left the three B subtotals 2.00 short of the printed grand total. The 300 dpi rotated page reads $12,338.81 and the three subtotals then sum EXACTLY to 25,514.45 - the arithmetic identity, not a glyph preference, settled it. Rotation sign for pages 4-6 and 8-10 is -90 (CW); a +90 render came out upside down.
itemized.notes: Pages: 1 cover, 2 Summary Page, 3 Schedule A form (blank, 'See Attached'), 4-6 Schedule A spreadsheet attachment (3 landscape pages, each with its own printed subtotal, grand total on p6), 7 Schedule B form (blank, 'See Attached'), 8-10 Schedule B spreadsheet attachment (3 landscape pages, grand total on p10). PRIVACY: the attachments print an Address column with every cell left blank by the filer (this is omission, not a county redaction - there is no black bar in this document); City and State were read from their own columns. Six Schedule A rows are marked 'In Kind' in the Type column and DO count toward the printed totals (which close to the cent); five of them appear again as in-kind expenditures on Schedule B, which is the filer's own treatment. One p6 date is printed with a period instead of the second slash ('6/4.2010', James Catlin) - the ISO value is kept because month/day/year are unambiguous, but the row carries needs_review=1 and the verbatim. Names kept verbatim include 'Beverly Varsv', 'Beky Burke', 'Rhonda Haives Maylett' (p5) vs 'Rhonda Hailes Maylett' (p5 row 1), 'Buisness', 'Fundrasier supplies', and 'Bruce W. Bastian Foundaiton'. Two Schedule A rows are other campaigns' committees ('Sim Gill for DA', 'Greg Skordas Campaign') and one is a union local; they are named contributors, not aggregates.
